scope: No Memory/query/write/cache changes, no new labels or losses, no task-head replacement, no fabricated spatial/temporal head ordering. These are adaptations of mechanisms, not full-paper reproductions.
cross_lane_audit_status: Only STATUS.json existed in the round-2 directory at writing. Same-round comparisons below cover this lane; coordinator must reconcile other lanes before counting or launching. No accepted count has been written to the global registry.

common_contract.inputs: Local[256], Base_forward[512], Gap_A/T/V_forward[512], real eight-head decomposition with value_dim=64, availability[3]. Backward halves remain their original causal zeros. Availability and actual history validity determine which evidence roles exist.
common_contract.output: Transform existing memory-read coordinates before the original Flat emotion_adapter. Preserve Local, local_skip, original adapter, normalization and task head. No new common output residual/zero bridge.
common_contract.mask: Use where before arithmetic to eliminate inactive NaN/Inf. Restore inactive role coordinates to exact zero after each operation. Padding/no-history bypass the entire transformation with the original Flat inputs. Never impute a missing modality.
common_contract.state: All inference/solver state is ephemeral per utterance. No batch statistics, persistent solver warm starts or random forward sampling. New parameter construction must preserve caller global RNG using the project's initialization isolation.
validation_before_counting: Identity initialization against original Flat including pre-clipping parameter/input gradients
Inactive NaN/Inf invariance and every legal modality mask
Finite backward and meaningful parameter updates after identity parameters move
No additional task evaluations, auxiliary objectives or Memory calls

candidates.title: Neural Spline Flows

sources_read.sections: Coupling transforms and monotonic rational-quadratic spline construction; analytic inverse

candidates.core: Alternating coupling splits condition positive bin widths/heights and positive knot derivatives on unchanged coordinates. Each transformed coordinate uses a monotone rational-quadratic interpolant, with analytic inverse and identity tails. Stacking alternating splits gives an invertible nonlinear multivariate transformation, not a scalar evidence gate.

exact_mapping.unit: For each genuine head h, concatenate [Base_h, Gap_A_h, Gap_T_h, Gap_V_h] into x_h[256]. Inactive role blocks are zero and fixed. Eight heads share parameters, with explicit head identity as context; there is no head-neighbour topology.
exact_mapping.layers: Four coupling steps with separate parameters. Steps alternate unchanged even/odd coordinate indices within every 64-coordinate role block. Each unchanged half has 128 coordinates; transformed half has 128.
exact_mapping.conditioner: Concatenate unchanged half[128], Local[256], availability[3], one-hot head[8]: 395 -> 128 -> 128 -> 128*23 with GELU hidden activations, no normalization/dropout. Output 8 width logits, 8 height logits, 7 interior derivative logits per transformed coordinate. This conditioner choice is an explicit task adaptation, not a new candidate mechanism.
exact_mapping.spline: K=8 bins, support [-3,3], linear identity tails. Minimum width, height and derivative are 0.001. Normalize width/height logits as in the pinned spline/coupling implementation. Boundary derivatives are one. Transform active target coordinates only; retain inactive zero coordinates exactly.
exact_mapping.readout: Reassemble all four 512-dimensional forward evidence roles in their original Flat positions, keep Local and backward halves unchanged, then call the original adapter exactly once.
exact_mapping.identity_init: Set final conditioner weights and width/height biases to zero; interior derivative bias is inverse_softplus(1-0.001). Equal knot widths/heights and unit derivatives give the identity map. Numerical identity and gradients must be checked; do not implement a parameter-equality early return that blocks learning.
exact_mapping.objective: Original task objective only. No likelihood, log-determinant penalty, base-density sampling or flow pretraining. Inverse/log-Jacobian are verification tools, not training losses. Conditional bijectivity is claimed only for active memory coordinates at fixed Local, availability and head identity.

candidates.hypothesis: A conditional invertible recalibration can change how cross-role evidence occupies the original adapter's coordinate space without irreversibly pooling or deleting evidence.
mechanism_tests: Forward/inverse round-trip on all active-coordinate patterns including tail inputs
Independent rational-quadratic bin formula and positive derivative check
After training-step perturbation, both split halves can change but inactive coordinates remain zero

novelty_audit.substantive_difference: None performs an analytically invertible monotone spline coupling stack. TabNet selects coordinates, NODE routes to leaves, and CRATE compresses/sparsifies. The distinction is the constrained bijective coupling algorithm, not the insertion position or conditioner MLP.
novelty_audit.same_round_overlap: Do not separately count RealNVP, NICE, affine coupling, Glow or other spline-flow variants in this round. DEQ uses an implicit non-bijective state solve; LRPCA decomposes low-rank plus sparse components. Other lanes require coordinator reconciliation.
novelty_audit.source_code_evidence: Pinned CouplingTransform splits identity/transformed features; PiecewiseRationalQuadraticCouplingTransform calls the positive-knot rational-quadratic operator and its analytic inverse.

risks: Without a density objective, generative/density claims do not transfer.
Invertibility deliberately cannot discard information; it may be inferior to denoising.
Inputs outside the fixed spline support remain unchanged in that step.
Four conditioners add material cost and parameters; profile rather than assuming negligible overhead.
Identity is mathematical; floating-point parity still requires an actual test.
candidates.decision: Accept as one substantive research candidate; no numerical validation or launch performed.

candidates.title: Learned Robust PCA: A Scalable Deep Unfolding Approach for High-Dimensional Outlier Detection

sources_read.sections: LRPCA alternating thresholding and scaled factor updates; finite unfolding versus feedforward-recurrent extension

sources_read.inspection: Spectral initialization, learned threshold/step arrays, simultaneous scaled updates, supervised reconstruction return

candidates.core: Threshold the matrix residual to estimate signed sparse corruption, then update two low-rank factors using their inverse Gram matrices as preconditioners. Both factors use the old factor pair for a simultaneous step. A spectral initializer precedes the finite learned iteration chain. The source also offers recurrent continuation, which is not selected here.

exact_mapping.matrix: Pack only available columns [Base_forward, active Gap roles in A/T/V order] into Y[512,C], C in {1,2,3}. Coordinates are already in the same OSRAM value space; columns are evidence roles, not pixels/time. Rank r=1 is fixed. C=1 uses exact identity because there is no cross-role redundancy to decompose.
exact_mapping.scale: Per-utterance s=max(mean(abs(Y)),1e-6). Zero Y bypasses the solver. All thresholds are relative to s; no batch estimate.
exact_mapping.initialization: S0=soft_threshold(Y,0.1*s). Deterministic thin SVD of Y-S0 produces rank-one U0=u1*sqrt(sigma1), V0=v1*sqrt(sigma1). Compute this initialization under no_grad, with no randomized svd_lowrank and no global RNG use. If sigma1 is zero, bypass with Y. The initial threshold is fixed, not a dormant trainable parameter.
exact_mapping.iterations: Fourteen learned updates after the spectral initialization, matching a 15-stage finite variant. At t=1..14, zeta_t=softplus(theta_t)*s (initial 0.1*0.8^t*s), eta_t=sigmoid(phi_t) (initial 0.5). S_t=soft_threshold(Y-U_t V_t^T,zeta_t); E_t=Y-U_t V_t^T-S_t; U_next=U_t+eta_t E_t V_t/max(V_t^T V_t,1e-6); V_next=V_t+eta_t E_t^T U_t/max(U_t^T U_t,1e-6). Both updates use U_t,V_t. All learned scalar arrays must be registered parameters.
exact_mapping.final_components: L=U_final V_final^T; S=soft_threshold(Y-L,zeta_14); R=Y-L-S. This final residual classification is explicit task readout adaptation.
exact_mapping.identity_init_and_readout: Use reconstructed evidence Y_new=L+a*S+R, evaluated stably as Y+(a-1)*S, where a=1-tanh(gamma), gamma initialized to zero. This is native component recombination at the original evidence input, not an added output branch. Unpack existing roles; Local, missing roles and backward halves retain original values. Source decomposition, rather than a primitive standalone gate, determines the component being reweighted.
exact_mapping.gradient_contract: Differentiate all fourteen scaled updates and final thresholding, but not the spectral initializer. The first optimizer step can update gamma; core parameters receive gradients after gamma leaves zero. This delayed-core behavior must be tested, not called frozen training.
exact_mapping.objective: Use only the existing task loss. Do not use source clean-matrix supervision, synthetic training data, source layerwise curriculum or an auxiliary recovery loss.

source_adaptations: Selected finite LRPCA core, not the paper's infinite feedforward-recurrent extension.

Deterministic detached spectral initialization replaces randomized differentiable source svd_lowrank. This avoids both global forward RNG consumption and undefined SVD gradients at repeated singular values; it intentionally omits gradients through initialization.
Rank-one Gram floors, bounded learned step sizes and data-scaled thresholds are numerical/task adaptations; recovery theorems are not claimed.
Component recombination preserves initial Flat inputs; the source supervised reconstruction head is not transferred.
candidates.hypothesis: A signed sparse disagreement component may distinguish a few conflicting value coordinates from shared cross-role structure; task training can learn whether to suppress or retain that component.
mechanism_tests: Independent one-step scaled-update reference verifies simultaneous rather than sequential factor updates
Synthetic signed rank-one-plus-sparse matrix validates decomposition behavior without becoming a training objective
Zero matrix, repeated singular values and rank-deficient factors remain finite
Scalar parameter updates after gamma perturbation; no dormant trainable initializer parameter

novelty_audit.substantive_difference: NMF models a nonnegative product and has no separate signed sparse residual or inverse-Gram factor scaling. CRATE applies sparse coding/ISTA after subspace attention and does not jointly solve low-rank-plus-sparse evidence decomposition. LRPCA retains coupled sparse classification and preconditioned low-rank factor updates, not merely another matrix-factorization rank or iteration count.
novelty_audit.same_round_overlap: Do not also count PCP/ADMM-RPCA, AltProj or another unrolled robust-PCA solver without proving a different substantive core. NSF is invertible coordinate transport; DEQ solves a general contractive state rather than low-rank/sparse factors. Other lanes require reconciliation.
novelty_audit.source_code_evidence: Pinned MatNet.forward computes thresholded residuals, V(V^T V)^-1 and U(U^T U)^-1 scaling, and simultaneous old-factor updates.

risks: Only two or three columns exist when active, so the low-rank-plus-sparse assumption is much less identifiable than in source high-dimensional recovery experiments.
A sparse disagreement may be useful evidence rather than corruption; improvement is a falsifiable hypothesis, not an assumed denoising benefit.
Detached initialization is a material backward-path adaptation and must stay documented.
Per-utterance SVD and fourteen updates require profiling despite small C.
No source recovery guarantee or full-paper reproduction claim is valid for this task.
candidates.decision: Accept as a finite-LRPCA mechanism adaptation with explicit detached-initializer exception; numerical behavior remains untested.

candidates.title: Deep Equilibrium Models

sources_read.sections: Root-based equilibrium forward computation and implicit differentiation theorem

sources_read.lines: 318-343: no-grad root solve and implicit transpose-Jacobian adjoint

candidates.core: A weight-tied nonlinear map is evaluated at its fixed point using a root solver without recording all forward iterations. Training solves a transpose-Jacobian linear fixed-point system for the implicit adjoint. The root-and-adjoint pair, rather than the choice of sequence backbone, is the transferred mechanism.

exact_mapping.unit: For each genuine head, x=[Base_h, Gap_A_h, Gap_T_h, Gap_V_h] in R^256 with repeated-coordinate active mask m. Context c=[Local256, availability3, head-onehot8] has 267 coordinates. No edges, learned slots or positional neighbourhoods.
exact_mapping.fixed_point: z*=f(z*;x,c), f(z)=x+0.9*m*Pbar*tanh(Qbar*(m*z)+C*c+b). P,Q are learned 256x256 matrices, C is 256x267, b is 256; Pbar=P/(1+||P||_F), Qbar=Q/(1+||Q||_F). This gives Lipschitz constant below 0.9 in z, no auxiliary Jacobian loss. P and Q are not constrained symmetric/transposes, so the map need not be a gradient field.
exact_mapping.solver: Implementation amendment authorized by coordinator: Picard fixed-point iteration replaces Broyden in both the forward root solve from z0=x and the implicit backward solve v=J_f(z*)^T v+upstream. The actual map has contraction bound below 0.9. Maximum 50 iterations for each; relative residual ||r||/(1+||state||) <=1e-6, checked again on returned state. Each utterance/head freezes independently on convergence; never use a batch-global stopping norm. No line search is needed for Picard. Exceeding tolerance is an explicit failure, with no unrolled-gradient fallback. No retained warm starts. A custom autograd Function evaluates the transpose-Jacobian solve at the detached converged root, retaining the genuine implicit adjoint.
exact_mapping.identity_init: Initialize P=0 and b=0, Q and C with isolated standard initialization. The unique fixed point is exactly x. Differentiate through Pbar and the implicit adjoint correctly; P must have a nonzero first-step gradient where the task signal permits. Avoid parameter-equality bypasses.
exact_mapping.readout: Unpack z* into the original forward evidence coordinates before Flat's existing adapter. Keep Local and backward zeros unchanged. Re-mask inactive coordinates after every solver evaluation. No-history/padding bypass.
exact_mapping.source_exclusions: Do not transfer Transformer-XL relative positions, mems/update_mems, language-model output layer, variational dropout, stacked pretraining mode, optional jac_loss_estimate or spectral-radius training loss. The paper's generic implicit-layer formulation is selected, not its full sequence-model architecture.

candidates.hypothesis: Joint nonlinear evidence consistency can be learned as a stable fixed-point relation instead of a prescribed finite aggregation trajectory.
mechanism_tests: Independent tiny linear fixed-point closed form and implicit parameter/input gradient reference
Forward and backward residuals below declared tolerance
Zero-P identity and original Flat gradient parity
Contractive bound verified for the actual map, including masks and parameter normalization
Example with asymmetric Jacobian to establish it is not scalar-potential gradient descent
Finite gradient for Frobenius norm at P=0

novelty_audit.substantive_difference: First-round equilibrium_aggregation optimizes a learned scalar potential with ten explicitly differentiated Nesterov steps. This candidate permits a nonconservative nonlinear map, solves f(z)-z=0 to tolerance and differentiates the equilibrium through an implicit adjoint. It is not the same energy optimizer moved to Flat input. RRN uses a prescribed finite LSTM message-update trajectory, without root solving or an implicit adjoint. If implementation falls back to a fixed unrolled map or recycles the EA energy, reject it as failing this distinction.
novelty_audit.same_round_overlap: Treat generic implicit-layer / DEQ variants as one candidate. A convex optimization layer differentiated by KKT may overlap strongly and needs a substantive program-level distinction before separate counting. LRPCA is finite explicit low-rank/sparse decomposition; NSF is analytic invertible coupling. Other lanes require coordinator reconciliation.
novelty_audit.source_code_evidence: Pinned _forward lines 320-322 solve under no_grad; lines 335-343 solve the transpose-Jacobian adjoint. This paired mechanism is absent from the first-round EA description.

risks: A substantive distinction from EA exists mathematically, but the coordinator must preserve it in implementation rather than count a renamed iterative aggregator.
Strict per-instance convergence is more expensive than the source's batch-global stopping rule.
Contractive normalization may underuse model capacity.
Fifty iterations are a finite numerical budget, not a universal convergence guarantee; failure must be surfaced.
Implicit differentiation needs careful hook lifetime, evaluation-mode behavior and zero-norm derivative handling; no implementation is included.
candidates.decision: Accept one generic DEQ mechanism adaptation, contingent on retaining both root solve and implicit adjoint as specified; not a full DEQ-Transformer reproduction.

candidates.title: Iterative Normalization: Beyond Standardization towards Efficient Whitening

sources_read.sections: Covariance normalization and iterative inverse square root

sources_read.inspection: Batch centering, trace-normalized covariance, power iteration and running means/projections for evaluation

candidates.core: Iterative covariance inverse-square-root whitening with learned affine output and training/evaluation statistics.
candidates.adaptation_considered: Within-utterance evidence whitening could remove cross-utterance statistics, but it would replace the source statistics semantics and remain a single normalization operator rather than a substantive structured readout block.
candidates.mask: A hypothetical within-utterance variant would exclude inactive roles before mean/covariance; no implementation or candidate protocol is proposed because it is rejected.

novelty_audit.substantive_difference: No sufficient task-level mechanism distinction from previously rejected primitive matrix-normalization/pooling directions.
novelty_audit.same_round_overlap: Do not count whitening, Newton-Schulz normalization, conditional whitening and IterNorm as separate meaningful methods.
novelty_audit.source_code_evidence: Pinned Lua implementation maintains running_means/running_projections and computes covariance over a batch.

risks: Original batch statistics violate utterance independence.
Replacing them with only a few evidence roles yields a rank-deficient covariance and does not resolve the method-complexity objection.
candidates.decision: Reject; do not count toward 20. No fifth qualified candidate was established in this lane.
